Ertalab.intro_en: Beep-beep! Good morning, friends! I am Kabu the robot. Let's say what we do in the morning!

I wash my face..sentence: I wash my face with water.

I have breakfast..sentence: I have breakfast with my family.

tests_en: Ali is washing his face. What does he say?
Laylo is putting on her dress. What does she say?

extras_en.matn_en: Sing and move: I get up, I get up! Stretch! I wash my face! I have breakfast! Yummy! I get dressed! Ready! Now you tell me: what do you do first in the morning?

Kunduzi.intro_en: Beep-beep! Hello, friends! Where are Ali and Laylo in the day? Let's find out!

I go to school..sentence: I go to school by bus.

I play with friends..sentence: I play with friends in the yard.

tests_en: It's lunchtime. What does Ali say?
Ali and Laylo are playing tag in the yard. What does Ali say?

extras_en.sarlavha_en: 🎭 Dialog: What do you do every day?
extras_en.matn_en: Ali asks: What do you do every day? Laylo says: I go to school. I have lunch. I play with friends! Now Ali asks you. What do you say? Say: I go to school!

Kechqurun.intro_en: Beep-beep! Good evening, friends! The sun is down. What do you do in the evening?

I do my homework..sentence: I do my homework at my desk.

I have dinner..sentence: I have dinner with my grandma.

I watch TV..sentence: I watch TV in the evening.

I go to bed..sentence: I go to bed at nine.

tests_en: Ali is drawing in his notebook at the desk. What does he say?
It's late and the stars are out. What do you do?

extras_en.matn_en: Game: Kabu is mixed up! I say: I go to bed. I have dinner. No, no! First dinner, then bed! Say it the right way: I have dinner. And then? Now you tell me: what do you do last in the evening?

Soat necha?.intro_en: Beep-beep! Tick-tock, tick-tock! I am Kabu, and I have a clock inside me. Let's learn to tell the time!

It's half past seven..sentence: It's half past seven. Breakfast time!

tests_en: Ali wants to know the time. What does he ask?
Look at the clock. What time is it?

extras_en.matn_en: Find it! Ali asks: What time is it? The big hand is on twelve, the small hand is on seven. So: It's seven o'clock! Now the big hand is on six. What time is it now? You answer!

Nima bo'ldi?.intro_en: Beep-beep! Hello, friends. Ali is in bed today. Let's ask him: what's the matter?
tests_en: Laylo is holding her tummy. What does she say?
Your friend looks sad. What do you ask?

extras_en.matn_en: Sing and show! What's the matter? What's the matter? Touch your head: I have a headache! Touch your tummy: I have a stomachache! Now I ask: What's the matter? You answer!

Shifokorda.intro_en: Beep-beep! Ali is at the hospital. Look, a kind nurse! What does she have?

Get well soon!.action_en: Draw a heart in the air!

tests_en: Who helps sick people at the hospital?
Your friend is sick. What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Nurse: Hello! What's the matter? Ali: I'm sick. I have a headache. The nurse uses a thermometer: Here is your medicine. Laylo says: Get well soon, Ali! Now you are Ali. The nurse asks: What's the matter? Answer!

Sog'lom bo'lamiz.intro_en: Beep-beep! I get power from my battery. How do you stay healthy and strong? Learn my four secrets!
tests_en: What do we do before lunch?
Ali is thirsty after football. What does Kabu say?

extras_en.matn_en: Game: If it's healthy, clap! If not, shake your head! Eat fruit! Clap! Drink water! Clap! Watch TV all night? No! Now you tell me: what do you do to be healthy?

Shahar joylari.intro_en: Beep-beep! Today we go around Tashkent by bus! Look out of the window. What places can you see?

library.sentence: I read books in the library.

zoo.sentence: I see lions at the zoo.

bakery.sentence: We buy hot bread at the bakery.

tests_en: Grandma wants hot bread. Where does she go?
Laylo wants to see monkeys and lions. Where does she go?

extras_en.sarlavha_en: 👀 Find it: where do we go?
extras_en.matn_en: Find it! Ali wants to read a book. Where does he go? Yes, the library! Laylo wants to see a lion: the zoo! Grandma wants hot bread. Where do you go? You answer!

Qayerda?.intro_en: Beep-beep! Laylo's cat is hiding again! Is it next to the box, behind it or in front of it? Let's find out!

Where is the park?.sentence: Excuse me, where is the park?

next to.sentence: The bakery is next to the park.

behind.sentence: The cat is behind the box.

in front of.sentence: I stand in front of the library.
in front of.action_en: Stand in front of your chair!

tests_en: The cat is at the back of the box. Where is it?
Ali can't find the park. What does he ask?

extras_en.matn_en: Sing: Where is the cat? Where is the cat? Next to the box! Behind the box! In front of the box! The cat is hiding again. I ask: Where is the cat? You answer!

Yo'l ko'rsatamiz.intro_en: Beep-beep! A boy is lost. He asks: Where is the zoo? Let's show him the way!

crossing.sentence: The crossing is next to the school.

tests_en: The arrow points left. What do we say?
Where is it safe to cross the street?

extras_en.matn_en: Boy: Excuse me, where is the zoo? Laylo: Go straight. Turn left at the bakery. The zoo is next to the park. Boy: Thank you! Now you show the way! The boy asks: Where is the library? What do you say?

Yo'l qoidalari.intro_en: Beep-beep! There are many cars in the street. Let's be careful and learn the road rules!

Look left and right!.sentence: Look left and right, then go.

bus stop.sentence: We wait at the bus stop.

tests_en: The traffic light is red. What do we say?
Ali is waiting for the bus. Where is he?

extras_en.matn_en: Game! I say a colour. Red: say Wait! and stand still. Green: say Look left and right! and then walk on the spot! Red! Green! Now you tell me: the light is red. What do we say?

Salat tayyorlaymiz.intro_en: Beep-beep! Today we help Mum in the kitchen. We have tomatoes and cucumbers. Let's make a salad!

Let's make a salad!.sentence: Let's make a salad with Mum!

mix.sentence: I mix the salad in the bowl.

bowl.sentence: Put the salad in a bowl.

tests_en: Laylo is stirring the salad with a spoon. What is she doing?
Where do we put the salad?

extras_en.matn_en: Find it! Tell me the salad steps. First: Let's make a salad! Then Mum cuts the tomatoes. Cut! Then we put them in a bowl and... what do we do? You answer!

Dasturxon.intro_en: Beep-beep! Guests are coming soon! What do we put on the table? Let's learn the words!

plate.sentence: Put a plate on the table.
plate.action_en: Put a plate on the table!

spoon.sentence: I eat soup with a spoon.

fork.sentence: I eat salad with a fork.

cup.sentence: A cup of tea for Grandma!
cup.action_en: Give the cup with two hands!

tests_en: We pour tea for Grandma. What do we pour it into?
Ali is eating plov. What does he use?

extras_en.matn_en: Sing and put! A plate, a plate, on the table! A spoon, a fork, on the table! A cup of tea, on the table! The table is ready! Now I show you a fork and ask: What's this? You answer!

Mehmon kutamiz.intro_en: Beep-beep! Knock-knock! A guest is here! Let's be polite and offer some tea.

Would you like some tea?.sentence: Grandma, would you like some tea?
Would you like some tea?.action_en: Give the cup with two hands!

No, thank you..action_en: Put your hand on your heart!

tests_en: The guest doesn't want tea. What does she say politely?
Grandma's plov is very tasty! What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Laylo: Would you like some tea? Guest: Yes, please. Ali: Would you like some plov? Guest: Yes, please! Mmm, it's delicious! Now you are the host! I am the guest. What do you say to me? Offer me some tea!

Men o'ynayapman.intro_en: Beep-beep! Hello, friends! I am Kabu the robot. What are you doing now? Let's say it!
tests_en: Ali has a book. Mum asks: What are you doing? What does Ali say?
Laylo wants to know what Ali is doing now. What does she ask?

extras_en.matn_en: A grown-up is Mum, and you are Ali. Mum asks: What are you doing? Act and answer: I'm playing. I'm reading. I'm eating. Now change roles. You ask: What are you doing?

U nima qilyapti?.intro_en: Beep-beep! Look at the family! Who is sleeping? Who is singing? Let's see!
tests_en: Laylo is singing. What do we say?
Ali and Laylo are in the park. They run fast. Which sentence is right?

extras_en.matn_en: A grown-up acts: sleeps, sings or runs. You guess and say: He's sleeping. She's singing. They're running. Then you act, and the grown-up asks: What are you doing? You answer: I'm singing!

Hayvonlar nima qilyapti?.intro_en: Beep-beep! We are in Granny's garden. Look at the animals! What are they doing?

The dog is running..sentence: The dog is running to Ali.

The birds are singing..sentence: The birds are singing in the tree.

The fish is swimming..sentence: The fish is swimming in the water.

tests_en: Look at the pond. Which sentence is right?
What is the dog doing?

extras_en.matn_en: Close your eyes. Listen! Tweet-tweet! Who is it? Say: The birds are singing. Splash! The fish is swimming. Now open your eyes. I ask: What is the cat doing? Answer with a full sentence!

Kecha.intro_en: Beep-beep! Hello, friends! Yesterday I went to the park. What did you do yesterday?

What did you do yesterday?.sentence: Laylo, what did you do yesterday?

I went to the park..sentence: Yesterday I went to the park.

tests_en: Yesterday Ali kicked a ball with his friends. What does he say?
Laylo wants to ask about yesterday. Which question is right?

extras_en.matn_en: Sing and move: Yesterday, yesterday, what did you do? I played football! I went to the park! Now I ask, and you tell me about you: What did you do yesterday?

Ko'rdim.intro_en: Beep-beep! Yesterday I saw a rainbow in the sky! What did you see?

I saw a rainbow..sentence: I saw a rainbow after the rain.
I saw a rainbow..action_en: Draw a rainbow in the air!

I saw a big dog..sentence: I saw a big dog. Woof!

tests_en: Yesterday Laylo saw seven colours in the sky. What does she say?
Yesterday Ali ate ice cream. Which sentence is right?

extras_en.matn_en: Laylo asks: What did you do yesterday? Ali answers: I saw a big dog! Laylo says: I saw a rainbow! I ate ice cream! Now you are Ali. What did you see yesterday? Say a full sentence!

Dam olish kuni.intro_en: Beep-beep! It's Monday. Ali has a story about his weekend. Let's listen!

I visited my granny..sentence: On Saturday I visited my granny.

We went to the zoo..sentence: On Sunday we went to the zoo.

It was fun!.sentence: We saw a giraffe. It was fun!

tests_en: On Saturday Ali went to his granny's house. What does he say?
The zoo was great! What do we say?

extras_en.matn_en: Draw three cards: Granny, a giraffe and a happy face. Pick a card and say: I visited my granny. We went to the zoo. It was fun! Now say all three and tell me about your weekend!

Katta sholg'om.intro_en: Beep-beep! Grandpa has a giant turnip. He pulls and pulls. Who can help him?
tests_en: Who came last and helped to pull the turnip?
The turnip is out! What does everyone shout?

extras_en.matn_en: Stand in a line and pull as you sing: Pull, pull, pull! The turnip is big! The dog comes, the cat comes, but no! The mouse comes: Pull, pull, pull! Hooray! Now tell the story. Who came last? Say: The mouse!

Zumrad va Qimmat.intro_en: Beep-beep! This is an Uzbek fairy tale. Zumrad is kind. Qimmat is lazy. Let's listen!

She is kind..action_en: Put your hand on your heart!

She is lazy..sentence: Qimmat doesn't help. She is lazy.

chest.sentence: The chest is full of gold!

tests_en: Zumrad helps an old man. What is she like?
Where does Zumrad meet the old man?

extras_en.matn_en: I tell, you guess! Who helps the old man carry the wood? Say: Zumrad. She is kind. Who lies down and doesn't help? Qimmat. She is lazy. Zumrad gets gold in her chest! And you? Say: I am kind!

Sher va sichqon.intro_en: Beep-beep! A big lion and a little mouse. Can a little mouse help a big lion? Let's listen!

lion.sentence: The lion is big and strong.

net.sentence: The lion is in a net.

Thank you, little mouse!.sentence: The lion says, Thank you, little mouse!

tests_en: The lion is in a net. What does he shout?
The mouse bites the net and the lion is free. What does the lion say?

extras_en.matn_en: A grown-up is the lion, you are the mouse. The lion is in a net and shouts: Help me! Help me! Run to him, bite the net and say: I can help you! The lion says: Thank you, little mouse! Now change roles: you are the lion!

Maktabga tayyorman!.intro_en: Beep-beep! Today is our graduation! You can speak English now. I am so proud of you!

diploma.sentence: Here is your diploma. Well done!

I'm ready for school!.sentence: I'm six. I'm ready for school!

We did it!.action_en: Jump and give a high five!

tests_en: Ali has a new school bag. What does he say?
You are on the stage. What do you say first?

extras_en.matn_en: Go on the stage and tell everyone about you: Hello! My name is… I am six. I live in… I like… At the end say loudly: I'm ready for school! Everyone claps and shouts: We did it!

scenarios.name: Maktabga kechikmaymiz
scenarios.goal: Bola oyisining savollariga javob berib, ertalabki ishlarini va vaqtni aytadi
scenarios.intro: Bip-bip! Ertalab bo'ldi. Oyi Alini uyg'otyapti. Sen Ali bo'lasan — oyingning savollariga javob ber!
scenarios.intro_en: Beep-beep! It's morning. Mum is waking Ali up. You are Ali. Answer Mum!

scene.image_prompt: Mum waking up Ali in his cozy bedroom in the morning, a wall clock showing seven, sunlight through the window, soft 3D cartoon scene for kids, warm colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Good morning, Ali! Get up, please!
Good morning, Mum! What time is it?
It's seven o'clock. Wash your face!
OK! I get up. I wash my face.
Well done! Now have breakfast, please.
Thank you, Mum! Then I get dressed.
It's half past seven. Let's go!
I'm ready! I go to school. Bye, Mum!

questions.q: Ali soatni bilmoqchi. U oyisidan nima deb so'radi?
questions.q_en: Ali wants to know the time. What does he ask Mum?
questions.why: Barakalla! [en]What time is it?[/en] — soat necha?
questions.why_en: Well done! What time is it?

questions.q_en: What time does Ali go to school?
questions.why: To'g'ri! [en]It's half past seven.[/en] — soat yetti yarim.

questions.q_en: What does Ali do after breakfast?
questions.why: Zo'r! [en]I get dressed.[/en] — kiyinaman.

scenarios.name: Poliklinikada
scenarios.goal: Bola hamshiraga nima og'riyotganini aytadi va maslahatni tushunadi
scenarios.intro: Bip-bip! Laylo kasal bo'lib qoldi. U oyisi bilan poliklinikaga keldi. Sen Laylo bo'lasan — hamshira opaga nima bo'lganini ayt!
scenarios.intro_en: Beep-beep! Laylo is sick. She is at the clinic with her mum. You are Laylo. Tell the nurse what's the matter!

scene.image_prompt: A friendly nurse with a thermometer talking to Laylo sitting on a chair in a bright clinic room, her mum beside her, soft 3D cartoon scene for kids, warm colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hello, Laylo! What's the matter?
Hello! I'm sick. I have a headache.
Oh dear! Here is the thermometer.
I have a stomachache too.
Here is your medicine. Drink water and sleep well!
dialog.uz: mana doring. suv ich va yaxshi uxla!

dialog.say: OK! Thank you, nurse!
And eat fruit! Get well soon, Laylo!
dialog.uz: meva ham ye! tezroq tuzal, Laylo!

dialog.say: Thank you! Goodbye!

questions.q_en: What does the nurse ask Laylo?
questions.why: Barakalla! [en]What's the matter?[/en] — nima bo'ldi?

questions.q: Layloning boshi og'riyapti. U nima dedi?
questions.q_en: Laylo's head hurts. What does she say?
questions.why: To'g'ri! [en]I have a headache.[/en] — boshim og'riyapti.

questions.q_en: What does the nurse say at the end?
questions.why: Zo'r! [en]Get well soon![/en] — tezroq tuzal!

scenarios.name: Hayvonot bog'iga yo'l
scenarios.goal: Bola shaharda yo'l so'raydi va yo'l ko'rsatmasini tushunadi
scenarios.intro: Bip-bip! Ali va dadasi Toshkentda hayvonot bog'iga ketyapti, lekin yo'lni bilishmaydi. Sen Ali bo'lasan — politsiyachi amakidan yo'l so'ra!
scenarios.intro_en: Beep-beep! Ali and his dad are going to the zoo in Tashkent, but they don't know the way. You are Ali. Ask the police officer!

scene.image_prompt: Ali and his dad asking a friendly police officer for directions on a sunny Tashkent street with a zebra crossing and a traffic light, soft 3D cartoon scene for kids, warm colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Excuse me! Where is the zoo?
Go straight. Then turn left at the bakery.
dialog.uz: to'g'riga yur. keyin novvoyxonada chapga buril.

dialog.say: Turn left at the bakery. OK!
The zoo is next to the park.
Is there a crossing?
Yes. Wait for the green light. Look left and right!
dialog.uz: ha. yashil chiroqni kut. chapga va o'ngga qara!

dialog.say: Thank you very much! Goodbye!
You're welcome! Have fun at the zoo!

questions.q: Ali yo'l so'rash uchun nima dedi?
questions.q_en: How does Ali ask the way?
options: 🗺️ Excuse me! Where is the zoo?
questions.why: Barakalla! [en]Excuse me! Where is the zoo?[/en] — kechirasiz, hayvonot bog'i qayerda?
questions.why_en: Well done! Excuse me! Where is the zoo?

questions.q_en: Where is the zoo?
questions.why: To'g'ri! [en]next to the park[/en] — bog'ning yonida.
questions.why_en: Yes! It's next to the park.

questions.q_en: What do we do before we cross the street?
questions.why: Zo'r! [en]Look left and right![/en] — chapga va o'ngga qara!

scenarios.name: Buvijon mehmonga keldi
scenarios.goal: Bola mehmonni kutib oladi, choy va salat taklif qiladi
scenarios.intro: Bip-bip! Taq-taq! Buvijon mehmonga keldi! Sen Laylo bo'lasan — buvijonni kutib ol, choy va salat taklif qil!
scenarios.intro_en: Beep-beep! Knock-knock! Grandma is here! You are Laylo. Say hello and offer her tea and salad!

scene.image_prompt: Laylo welcoming her grandma at a low table with a teapot, piyola tea cups, round non bread and a salad bowl, Ali smiling nearby, soft 3D cartoon scene for kids, warm colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hello, Grandma! Come in, please!
Hello, Laylo! What a nice table!
Sit down, please. Would you like some tea?
Yes, please. Thank you, my dear.
Here you are. Would you like some salad?
Yes, please! Mmm, it's delicious!
Ali and I made it with Mum!
dialog.uz: uni Ali ikkalamiz oyim bilan tayyorladik!

dialog.say: Well done, children! You are good helpers!

questions.q: Laylo buvijonga choyni qanday taklif qildi?
questions.q_en: How does Laylo offer tea to Grandma?
questions.why: Barakalla! [en]Would you like some tea?[/en] — choy ichasizmi?
questions.why_en: Well done! Would you like some tea?

questions.q: Buvijon choy ichmoqchi. U nima dedi?
questions.q_en: Grandma wants tea. What does she say?
questions.why: To'g'ri! [en]Yes, please.[/en] — ha, iltimos.

questions.q_en: What does Grandma say about the salad?
questions.why: Zo'r! [en]It's delicious![/en] — juda mazali!

scenarios.name: Telefonda: hozir nima qilyapsan?
scenarios.name_en: On the phone: What are you doing?
scenarios.goal: Bola telefonda do'stiga hozir nima qilayotganini aytadi va undan so'raydi
scenarios.intro: Laylo Aliga qo'ng'iroq qildi. Ular hozir nima qilyapti? Sen Ali bo'lasan — javob ber va o'zing ham so'ra!
scenarios.intro_en: Laylo calls Ali on the phone. What are they doing now? You are Ali!

scene.image_prompt: Ali at home talking on a phone with a toy car in his hand and a cat sleeping on the sofa, Laylo on the phone in her room with a book, split view, soft 3D cartoon scene for kids, warm colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hello, Ali! It's Laylo.
Hi, Laylo! What are you doing?
I'm reading a book. And you?
I'm playing with my car.
Where is your cat?
The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
Let's play in the park!
OK! See you soon!

questions.q_en: What is Laylo doing?
questions.why: To'g'ri! Laylo kitob o'qiyapti: [en]I'm reading a book.[/en]

questions.q_en: What is Ali's cat doing?
questions.why: Barakalla! [en]The cat is sleeping.[/en]
questions.why_en: Well done! The cat is sleeping.

questions.q: Laylo so'radi: [en]And you?[/en] Ali nima deydi?
questions.q_en: Laylo asks: And you? What does Ali say?
questions.why: To'g'ri! Ali o'ynayapti: [en]I'm playing with my car.[/en]
questions.why_en: Yes! I'm playing with my car.

scenarios.name: Dushanba ertalab bog'chada
scenarios.goal: Bola do'stiga dam olish kunida nima qilganini gapirib beradi va undan so'raydi
scenarios.intro: Dushanba ertalab Ali va Laylo bog'chada uchrashdi. Dam olish kunida ular nima qilishdi? Sen Laylo bo'lasan — so'ra va gapirib ber!
scenarios.intro_en: It's Monday morning. Ali and Laylo talk about the weekend. You are Laylo!

scene.image_prompt: Ali and Laylo meeting happily in a sunny kindergarten yard in the morning, Laylo showing Ali her drawing of a giraffe, soft 3D cartoon scene for kids, warm colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Good morning, Laylo!
Good morning, Ali! What did you do at the weekend?
dialog.uz: xayrli tong, Ali! dam olish kunida nima qilding?

dialog.say: I visited my granny. We ate plov.
Yummy! I went to the zoo with Mum and Dad.
dialog.uz: mazali! oyim va dadam bilan hayvonot bog'iga bordim

dialog.say: Wow! What did you see?
I saw a big giraffe!
Did you eat ice cream?
Yes, I did! It was fun!

questions.q: Ali dam olish kunida qayerga bordi?
questions.q_en: Where did Ali go at the weekend?
questions.why: To'g'ri! Ali buvijonnikiga bordi: [en]I visited my granny.[/en]

questions.q_en: What did Laylo see at the zoo?
questions.why: Barakalla! [en]I saw a big giraffe![/en]
questions.why_en: Well done! She saw a big giraffe.

questions.q_en: What did Laylo say at the end?
questions.why: To'g'ri! [en]It was fun![/en] — juda qiziq bo'ldi!

scenarios.name: Yangi ustoz bilan tanishuv
scenarios.goal: Bola maktabdagi yangi ustozga o'zini tanishtiradi va sevimli ertagini qisqa gapirib beradi
scenarios.intro: Ali maktabga keldi. Yangi ustoz u bilan tanishmoqchi. Sen Ali bo'lasan — o'zingni tanishtir va ertak aytib ber!
scenarios.intro_en: Ali is at school. He meets his new teacher. You are Ali. Tell her about you!

scene.image_prompt: Ali with a new backpack shaking hands with a smiling teacher at the school door, Laylo waving nearby, soft 3D cartoon scene for kids, warm colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Hello! What's your name?
Hello! My name is Ali. I am six.
Nice to meet you, Ali! What do you like?
dialog.uz: tanishganimdan xursandman, Ali! nimani yaxshi ko'rasan?

dialog.say: I like fairy tales!
Me too! Tell me a fairy tale, please.
dialog.uz: men ham! menga bir ertak aytib ber, iltimos

dialog.say: The lion is in a net. The little mouse helps him.
dialog.uz: sher to'rda. kichkina sichqon unga yordam beradi

dialog.say: Very good, Ali! Are you ready for school?
Yes! I'm ready for school!

questions.q_en: How old is Ali?
questions.why: To'g'ri! [en]I am six.[/en] — olti yoshdaman.

questions.q_en: Which fairy tale did Ali tell?
questions.why: Barakalla! Sher va sichqon — [en]The Lion and the Mouse[/en].
questions.why_en: Well done! The Lion and the Mouse.

questions.q: Ustoz so'radi: [en]Are you ready for school?[/en] Ali nima dedi?
questions.q_en: The teacher asks: Are you ready for school? What does Ali say?
questions.why: To'g'ri! [en]Yes! I'm ready for school![/en]
